You are a code worker editing the freytag-forge repo. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files ONLY under the current working directory; NEVER edit anything under /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge directly. Do NOT git commit, do NOT git add -A, do NOT touch .git. Do not run the test suite; this task needs no Python changes. You cannot reach GitHub; do not try to run real `gh` commands.

TASK: the manual production promotion workflow must refuse a SHA that has not passed the nightly suite.

BACKGROUND: slow end-to-end tests now run only in .github/workflows/coverage-nightly.yml (workflow name 'coverage-nightly', daily cron on main plus workflow_dispatch), not in PR CI. .github/workflows/promote-production.yml (workflow_dispatch only) has a job `validate-staged-sha` whose step `id: validate` picks the candidate SHA (input or newest successfully staged SHA on main) and writes it to `steps.validate.outputs.sha`. Then `deploy-production` needs that job.

OWNED FILES (edit nothing else): .github/workflows/promote-production.yml, docs/railway-production-promotion.md.

DO:
1. In job `validate-staged-sha`, add a NEW step right after the `validate` step, named exactly `Require a passing nightly run for the SHA`, with env `CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.sha }}` and `GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}`. Its run script starts with `set -euo pipefail` and must decide using exactly this command:
   `gh run list --workflow coverage-nightly.yml --commit "$CANDIDATE_SHA" --status success --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq length`
   If the output is not 1, print to stderr a short plain message that names the SHA, says no successful coverage-nightly run exists for it, and says how to get one: `gh workflow run coverage-nightly.yml --ref main` (this tests main's current head, so it only helps when the SHA is main's head), then exit 1. On success, append one line to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY naming the SHA as nightly-verified. Do not change candidate selection or any other step or job.
2. docs/railway-production-promotion.md, 'Release flow' step 2: add one plain sentence saying promotion also requires a successful coverage-nightly run on that exact SHA, and that a manual dispatch of coverage-nightly on main covers a SHA that is main's head.
3. Export your work: `git add -- .github/workflows/promote-production.yml docs/railway-production-promotion.md && mkdir -p /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/promote-nightly-gate-out && git diff --cached > /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/promote-nightly-gate-out/gate.patch`.
tasks.check:
bash -c 'set -u -o pipefail; PY=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python; OUT=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/promote-nightly-gate-out; mkdir -p $OUT; git add -- .github/workflows/promote-production.yml docs/railway-production-promotion.md; bad=$(git status --porcelain | grep -v -E "^M  " || true); [ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "FAIL stray files:"; echo "$bad"; exit 1; }; git diff --cached > $OUT/gate.patch; git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qx docs/railway-production-promotion.md || { echo FAIL docs not updated; exit 1; }; grep -qi nightly docs/railway-production-promotion.md || { echo FAIL docs lack nightly; exit 1; }; T=$(mktemp -d); $PY - "$T" <<"EOF" || exit 1
import sys, yaml
t = sys.argv[1]
wf = yaml.safe_load(open(".github/workflows/promote-production.yml"))
job = wf["jobs"]["validate-staged-sha"]
names = [s.get("name") for s in job["steps"]]
step = next((s for s in job["steps"] if s.get("name") == "Require a passing nightly run for the SHA"), None)
if step is None: sys.exit(f"FAIL step missing; steps are {names}")
ids = [s.get("id") for s in job["steps"]]
if job["steps"].index(step) != ids.index("validate") + 1: sys.exit("FAIL step must come right after validate")
if "steps.validate.outputs.sha" not in str(step.get("env", {}).get("CANDIDATE_SHA", "")): sys.exit("FAIL CANDIDATE_SHA env not from validate output")
if "validate-staged-sha" not in str(wf["jobs"]["deploy-production"]["needs"]): sys.exit("FAIL deploy-production no longer needs validate-staged-sha")
open(f"{t}/step.sh", "w").write(step["run"])
print("yaml ok")
EOF
mkdir -p $T/bin; printf "%s\n" "#!/bin/bash" "echo \"\$*\" >> $T/calls" "case \"\$*\" in *\"run list --workflow coverage-nightly.yml --commit \$CANDIDATE_SHA --status success\"*) echo \$FAKE_COUNT;; *) echo unexpected gh call: \"\$*\" >&2; exit 9;; esac" > $T/bin/gh; chmod +x $T/bin/gh; SHA=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567; PATH=$T/bin:$PATH CANDIDATE_SHA=$SHA FAKE_COUNT=1 GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY=$T/sum bash $T/step.sh || { echo FAIL step rejects a nightly-passed SHA; cat $T/calls; exit 1; }; grep -q $SHA $T/sum || { echo FAIL summary lacks SHA; exit 1; }; PATH=$T/bin:$PATH CANDIDATE_SHA=$SHA FAKE_COUNT=0 GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY=$T/sum bash $T/step.sh 2>$T/err && { echo FAIL step accepts a SHA without a nightly run; exit 1; }; cat $T/err; grep -q $SHA $T/err && grep -q "gh workflow run coverage-nightly.yml" $T/err || { echo FAIL refusal message lacks SHA or fix command; exit 1; }; echo PASS'
